name: portable-env
description: Project-local portable development environments for Bun, Node.js, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Python, Java, Zig, MariaDB and PostgreSQL, driven by a declarative require.penv file.

interface.longDescription: Build extraction-based development environments inside a project's .penv directory. Runtimes and versions are declared in require.penv and activated per terminal session without version managers, PATH edits or registry writes.
defaultPrompt: Use $portable-env to set up a .penv environment for the runtimes this project needs.
Use $portable-env to add Node.js and PostgreSQL to require.penv and activate them.
